sections.title: Plant form
sections.text: Common thyme is an evergreen, woody-based Mediterranean subshrub, usually about 10–30 cm tall and 15–40 cm wide. Its tiny opposite leaves are 3–8 mm long; its small, two-lipped flowers are white to pink or purple and appear in clusters.

sections.title: Kitchen herb
sections.text: The aromatic leaves are used fresh or dried to season food. The plate’s compact flowering mound matches this species.
